summary: Reviewed 9 units. Total issues: 3 error, 22 minor (21 with machine patch). Errors: unit 1 Hindi turns nṝn into 'heroes'; unit 5 Hindi adds the object 'them' to tūtot; unit 9 refrain wording deviates from the glossary (loudly/at). Other points: brahman rendered as hymn in unit 4; manave vs the Names-stay-names rule (Manu) in unit 7; vīrya/tavasya and invented 'battle' in unit 8; unit 6 gram of priyam; unit 5 tūtot root (likely √tud, to be verified). The unit 8 flag (digit 1 = independent svarita) is confirmed in the Devanagari (स्य१मनु). Unit 3 left ok. No regrouping suggested.
